summary: legal checked in 6 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for Woot data rights and any affiliate/advertising use; conditional for ordinary reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, keep permission outreach unsent, and authorize only read-only evidence work. Evidence: Woot documentation provides API access but not redistribution rights; current terms restrict commercial/public use and derivative data use; accuracy/freshness, security, measurement, attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Fleet compliance is technical-only: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown. Incomplete telemetry is not independently a blocker for ordinary growth, but failed or unknown site checks require site-specific remediation or a concrete parked/private decision. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Progress is evidenced by official Woot documentation, public terms/support records, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms. No task is closable. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Do not change production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, launch state, or send outreach.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price terms, and affiliate/advertising rights. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log/vendor/incident inventory.

Site and checklist decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked and private. Both are scaffold/parked, analytics is not configured, and compliance reachability currently fails with network errors; audience, disclosures, consent, monetization, and operational health are therefore unknown. Smallest next action: attach dated execution-owner verification, reachability, disclosure, consent, analytics, terms, monetization, and explicit launch-decision evidence while preserving parked/private status. For other sites with compliance pass, ordinary reversible growth may continue only within existing boundaries; do not infer legal clearance from aggregate compliance or revenue telemetry.

Compliance, data-quality, analytics, and revenue disposition: do not block ordinary reversible growth solely because telemetry is incomplete, but do not make financial or causal claims. Compliance reports 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown with open banner, consent, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics has 39 configured sites, with permission/collector failures on some GSC properties; repair the listed source permissions without treating failures as zero. Revenue reports $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21, including an unattributable provider row; preserve it as unattributed and do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or lift. Existing measurement, failure-repair, ownership, security, attribution, and rollback work remains containment-only.

Retain existing legal work only. No new proposal, change request, deployment, monetization expansion, dependency, telemetry, spend, or external outreach is recommended this cycle. Next evidence action is the consolidated SearchWoot read-only bundle; after attachment, Legal should re-evaluate each data-use item and close only tasks whose required evidence is actually complete.
